landing.badge: No-Intro & 1G1R Standard • Automatic M3U Playlists • 3D Box Studio
landing.heroSubtitle: Transform chaotic ROM dumps, multi-disc chaos, and duplicate piles into a clean 1G1R collection for Batocera, OnionOS, RetroPie, EmuDeck, or Miyoo Mini.
landing.feature1Desc: Intelligently identifies the best version (USA/EUR, final revision, clean dumps) and protects fan translations & ROM hacks.
landing.feature2Desc: Detects Disc 1, Disc 2, and multi-track bin/cue sets. Creates seamless .m3u playlists with 1-click batch scripts.
landing.feature3Desc: Converts cryptic filenames (e.g. smw_v1.0_[!].sfc) to standard clean names with region tags and badges.
landing.feature4Desc: Generates custom 3D game covers with realistic lighting, spine options, and multi-format presets for high-res export.
landing.feature5Desc: Quickly sweeps away orphaned .nfo, .txt, Thumbs.db, and obsolete cache files that clutter your microSD card.
landing.feature6Desc: Simulate and verify all renaming and moving actions before touching a single file. Complete rollback history included.
landing.compareSubtitle: See how your folder transforms with automatic organization.
landing.faq1Q: Do my ROMs leave my computer or get uploaded to a cloud?
landing.faq1A: No! Everything runs 100% locally inside your web browser via the modern File System Access API. Your files never leave your computer.
landing.faq2A: 1G1R ensures you keep exactly one optimal version of each game in your library, avoiding 10 identical regional releases while preserving your preferred language.
landing.faq3Q: Are fan translations and ROM hacks kept safe?
landing.faq3A: Yes! The deduplication engine recognizes translation and hack tags ([T+Ger], [t1], Kaizo, etc.) and isolates them so they are never marked as duplicates.
landing.faq4Q: How do M3U playlists work on handheld emulators?
landing.faq4A: M3U files list all discs of a multi-disc game in order. RetroArch and frontend systems treat the single .m3u as the game, preventing multi-disc clutter in your game menus.

features8.sectionTitle: The 8 Core Capabilities of ROM Collection Manager
features8.sectionSubtitle: Specifically crafted for retro gamers who value clean libraries on Batocera, RetroArch, or Steam Deck.
features8.f1Desc: 1 Game 1 Region: Who needs 5 versions of the same game? The tool detects clones, betas, and regions (USA, Japan, Europe) and automatically recommends the best final release.
features8.f2Desc: Multi-disc games (Amiga, PS1, Saturn) are automatically packaged into dedicated subfolders with an .m3u playlist.
features8.f3Desc: Whether CPC, SNES, Mega Drive, Game Boy, or PlayStation: Based on file extensions and paths, the manager sorts messy folders into clear directories.
features8.f4Desc: Removes annoying dump tags like [!], (v1.1), [b1], and moves leading articles to the back.
features8.f5Desc: Ideal for handhelds: Isolates the top 200 retro games of all time with 1 click into a separate _Top200/ folder.
features8.f6Desc: No data loss: Duplicates are moved to a separate _Duplicates/ folder. Full control guaranteed.
features8.f7Desc: Patched fan translations ([T+Ger]), Kaizo hacks, and homebrews are recognized and never deleted as duplicates!
features8.f8Desc: Turn flat 2D box art into tactile 3D box models with authentic spine, glossy finish, and system templates in seconds.

multiDiscDeep.title: Multi-Disc Games: Automatic Subfolders & M3U Playlists
multiDiscDeep.desc: Previously, for games spanning 2–4 disks (like Monkey Island or Final Fantasy), you had to manually create folders, move every disk, and write text files for M3U playlists.
multiDiscDeep.highlight: ROM Collection Manager handles this completely automatically for you.
multiDiscDeep.step1Desc: Detects related discs (Disk 1, Disk 2, Disc A, CD1) using filenames and pattern analysis.
multiDiscDeep.step2Desc: Creates e.g. Amiga/Secret of Monkey Island/ and moves all discs there.
multiDiscDeep.step3Desc: Writes the ready .m3u playlist right in the platform directory. RetroArch displays just 1 clean title!

emulators.title: Optimized for your Emulators & Retro Handhelds

faqList.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faqList.subtitle: Everything you need to know about scanning and execution.
faqList.q1: Are files deleted from my hard drive?
faqList.a1Text: The manager never permanently deletes your original games. Duplicates, cache files, and identified junk are safely moved to the _Duplicates/ folder. You can review this folder anytime.
faqList.q2: Do I still have to move multi-disc games by hand?
faqList.a2Text: The app automatically creates subfolders for every multi-disc game, moves all disks inside, and writes the ready-to-use .m3u playlist right beside them.
faqList.q3: Are my ROMs uploaded anywhere to the internet?
faqList.a3Text: Scanning and detection happen 100% locally in your web browser. Your gigabytes of ROM files never leave your computer.
